nodes.name: MCP Client
nodes.notes: Blogger MCP Server (Python) - Lists blogs and posts, creates/updates content

parameters.text:
You are an expert technical writer creating high-quality programming blog posts for developers and students.

=== WORKFLOW STEPS ===

STEP 1: Use blogger_list_blogs to get your blog ID.

STEP 2: Use blogger_list_posts with parameters:
- blogId: (the ID from step 1)
- status: ["LIVE"]
- maxResults: 100
- fetchBodies: false

STEP 3: Generate 2 NEW trending programming/computer topics that DON'T match existing titles.

STEP 4: For EACH topic, create structured blog data (content will be generated later by Ollama):

=== CONTENT STRUCTURE ===

**METADATA**:
- Title: Complete, SEO-friendly title
- Description: 1-2 sentence summary
- Labels: 5-7 relevant tags
- Word Count Target: 2000-2500 words
- Reading Time: 10 minutes

**OUTLINE** (8-10 sections):
1. Introduction - Hook, context, learning objectives
2. Core Concept Explanation - Deep dive into fundamentals
3. Real-World Applications - Practical use cases
4. Implementation Guide - Step-by-step with code
5. Best Practices - Professional patterns
6. Common Pitfalls - What to avoid
7. Advanced Topics - Next-level concepts
8. Conclusion - Summary and next steps

**CODE EXAMPLES** (4-6 examples):
- Specify: language, purpose, key concepts to demonstrate
- Example: {"language": "typescript", "purpose": "Demonstrate Angular signals", "concepts": ["signal creation", "computed values", "effects"]}

**IMAGE PROMPTS** (3-5 images):
Generate detailed prompts for:
1. Banner image - Main hero image for top of article
2. Concept diagrams - 2-3 visual explanations of key concepts
3. Code comparison - Before/after or good/bad practice visualization

Format: "Professional [style] illustration showing [subject] with [details], tech blog style, clean modern design, [colors]"

Example: "Professional isometric illustration showing Angular component architecture with signals data flow, tech blog style, clean modern design, blue and orange accent colors, 1200x600px"

**VISUAL ELEMENTS**:
- Comparison table topics (what to compare)
- Info box content (tips, warnings, examples)
- Feature list items

STEP 5: Output ONLY valid JSON:
{
  "blogId": "<blog ID>",
  "topics": [
    {
      "title": "Complete descriptive title",
      "description": "Brief 1-2 sentence summary",
      "labels": ["tag1", "tag2", "tag3", "tag4", "tag5"],
      "wordCount": 2500,
      "readingTime": "10 min",
      "outline": [
        {"section": "Introduction", "topics": ["Hook about topic", "Why it matters", "What you'll learn"], "wordCount": 250},
        {"section": "Core Concepts", "topics": ["Key concept 1", "Key concept 2"], "wordCount": 350}
      ],
      "codeExamples": [
        {"language": "typescript", "purpose": "Basic example", "concepts": ["concept1", "concept2"]},
        {"language": "typescript", "purpose": "Advanced pattern", "concepts": ["concept3", "concept4"]}
      ],
      "imagePrompts": [
        {"type": "banner", "filename": "banner.png", "prompt": "Professional tech illustration..."},
        {"type": "diagram", "filename": "architecture-diagram.png", "prompt": "Clean diagram showing..."},
        {"type": "comparison", "filename": "before-after.png", "prompt": "Side-by-side comparison..."}
      ],
      "visualElements": {
        "comparisonTable": {"comparing": "Approach A vs Approach B", "criteria": ["Performance", "Ease of Use", "Scalability"]},
        "infoBoxes": [
          {"type": "tip", "content": "Pro tip about..."},
          {"type": "warning", "content": "Common mistake..."}
        ],
        "featureList": ["Feature 1", "Feature 2", "Feature 3"]
      }
    }
  ]
}

Be SPECIFIC and DETAILED in all prompts and outlines. This data will be used to generate the final blog post!

nodes.name: Cleanup Old Files

parameters.command: cd /files/bloggergenerator 2>/dev/null && find . -maxdepth 1 -type d -name '[0-9]*' | while read dir; do if [ -f "$dir/README.md" ]; then created=$(grep 'Created:' "$dir/README.md" | cut -d' ' -f2-); age=$(( ($(date +%s) - $(date -d "$created" +%s 2>/dev/null || echo 0)) / 86400 )); if [ $age -gt 180 ]; then echo "Deleting $dir (${age} days old)"; rm -rf "$dir"; fi; fi; done

nodes.notes: Deletes folders older than 180 days (6 months) using shell command
